title: Private Cygnus XL cargo spacecraft departs the International Space Station after 6-month stay (video)
caption:
After six months docked at the International Space Station, the Cygnus XL freighter has departed. Instead of splashing down, it’s headed for a fiery reentry to test new heat shield technology. Here is why some space cargo ships are designed to burn up.
